text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after running through 
our first three years together with 
Daiichi Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—With that, the annual schedule is 
finalized. Please proceed with drafting 
the training menu accordingly.”

Without taking a single break, she spends 
her days living stoically. This would be a 
good time to take a breather, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you have any additional feedback, 
please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

She is getting the necessary rest, and 
above all, she wishes to move forward 
herself. In that case, unnecessary fuss is 
unneeded.

Over these three years, I've come to know 
her much deeper... I always respected her, 
but I've also learned to truly trust her.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, let's begin today's 
training.

Daiichi Ruby's footwork became 
increasingly refined, evolving day by day. 
Her growth was akin to that of an 
Umamusume about to enter her prime—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Heh...
choice_data_list: Ruby, your times are getting faster!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Please record it.

"She remains composed as ever, but deep 
down, she must be thrilled. After all, her 
mission is—"
choice_data_list:
(Because they are drawing ever closer to 
the pinnacle of radiance.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The young lady really is so totally epic!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Otsu-happy-wayy!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ms. Helios... And also...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san. Are the two of you out 
training as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We spotted you, so the two of us 
came over.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The way Ojo runs gets me way too hyped!! 
Wanna run together!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Would it be okay if I asked for a favor 
too?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Watching you run lit a fire in me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is a kind offer, but today's menu has 
already been decided.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Making a change would be difficult, so 
unfortunately—"

Deep down, she probably wants to run with 
everyone. ...I just have a feeling that's 
the case.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I look forward to working 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall be taking my leave, Trainer-san.
